name: mond-compat
subtitle: iPadOS Mode and opt-in SpringBoard Hybrid B test
description: Unsigned Mond fork for iPhone 17 / iOS 27.0.1. Version 3.0.7 adds an unverified SpringBoard windowing experiment with separate system backups and rollback. The earlier working 3.0.6 version remains in the version history. Device instability or boot loops are possible.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: Working iPadOS mode plus experimental Hybrid B
apps.localizedDescription: The normal iPadOS Mode remains available. Hybrid B separately tests iPhone DeviceClassNumber=1 with five iPad flags and three native SpringBoard windowing preferences. The app saves/exports both original system files, verifies disk read-back, and offers two rollback paths. Not proven on physical iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Hybrid B (experimental): three SpringBoard windowing preferences and iPhone class 1 with all five existing iPadOS capability flags. On-disk writes are checked; runtime behavior has not been verified.
versions.changelog: Add separate guarded Hybrid B test with read-only SpringBoard preference diagnostics, exact backups for both MobileGestalt and SpringBoard, native Files export, rollback of both states, and independent three-key restore. Preserves prior class-3 working mode. No automatic reboot. Risk: SpringBoard may ignore the prefs or iOS may bootloop.

versions.localizedDescription: Hybrid layout A/B test with exact known-working iPadOS restore.
versions.changelog: Add an opt-in iPhone-class plus five-flag test for iPhone18,3/iOS 27.0.1 without changing the working iPadOS toggle. Capture and verify a complete pre-test class-3 snapshot; export it via Files, restore it exactly, and display the class/flag state in read-only diagnostics. Require original backup and matching layout; verify written bytes before reporting success. Hybrid UI behavior remains unverified; no automatic respring or reboot.
